_comment: Update weekly specials. weekOf should be the Monday of the current week.

items.name: Lemon Chicken Orzo Soup
items.label: Soup of the Day
items.description: Tender chicken, orzo pasta, carrots, celery, onion, and spinach simmered in a bright, lemony broth.

items.name: Mediterranean Farro Salad
items.label: Seasonal Salad
items.description: Pearled farro tossed with cucumber, roasted red peppers, Kalamata olives, feta crumbles, and a bright lemon vinaigrette.

items.name: Roast Beef & Provolone Pressed
items.label: Featured Pressed Sandwich
items.description: Warm roast beef layered with melted provolone, roasted red peppers, horseradish aioli, and crispy onions on our house bread, pressed crisp.
notes: Served with pickle and Featured Side

items.name: Italian Pasta Salad
items.label: Featured Side
items.description: Tri-color rotini tossed with pepperoni, mozzarella, grape tomatoes, bell peppers, red onion, pepperoncini, Kalamata olives, Parmesan, and Italian dressing.

items.name: Key Lime Cheesecake
items.label: Sweet Bite of the Day
items.description: Creamy key lime cheesecake on a buttery graham cracker crust, topped with whipped cream.
